Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Erwachsenenpsychiatrie in Zofingen verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

description:

Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified

to join the school from: 24.08.2026

Your profile
The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.  

About us
Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.
The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.
There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer
Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply
Deadline for applications: 05.08.2026
Early applications are encouraged.  We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate.  Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE

Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging and transformational holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework.  The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 480 students aged 7 -18 representing 70 nations.  In their final years students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme but our distinct learning philosophy begins to become embedded from our youngest students. The junior school is a connected part of the whole school but is also a distinct section separate from the senior school with a dedicated focus on Year 2-8 students.

The school wishes to appoint a teaching assistant for the junior school to work primarily with students in Years 7 and 8.  Experience of working in an international school context would be a distinct advantage. It is expected that this post will involve supporting approximately 20-30 hours per week. This is a term-time only position.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

To support teaching staff in the development and education of pupils including the provision of specialist skills as appropriate.

Support for students (either individually or in groups)
Support the activities of individuals or groups, specifically those with EAL considerations.
Establish and maintain relationships with individual pupils and groups.
Contribute to Individual Education Plans as appropriate.
Support pupils during learning activities.
Promote pupils’ social and emotional development.
Contribute to the health and well-being of pupils.
Provide support for bilingual/multilingual pupils (where appropriate to the focus of the role).
Support children with specific needs (where appropriate to the focus of the role), for example, sensory and/or physical impairment, cognitive or learning difficulties, behavioural, emotional and social development needs, communication and interaction difficulties.
Support for Gifted and Talented pupils.
Support pupils with their literacy and numeracy skills.
Support pupils to access the curriculum.
Dealing with the personal care needs of children where appropriate in line with the guidance of the school.

Support for the teacher(s)
Observe and report on pupil performance.
Contribute to the planning and evaluation of learning activities.
Assist in preparing and maintaining the learning environment.
Contribute to the management of pupils’ behaviour.
Contribute to maintaining pupils’ records.
Support the maintenance of pupils’ safety and security.
Supervise the whole class for a short time in an emergency (normally for a period less than a whole lesson until the teacher returns or alternative arrangements are made) or for a very short period of planned absence for less than a whole lesson.
Undertake routine marking in line with the school policy.
Provide administrative support, e.g. produce worksheets, invigilate examinations, etc.

Support for the School
Support the development and effectiveness of team work within the school environment.
Develop and maintain working relationships with other professionals.
Liaise with parents as appropriate.
Review and develop your own professional practice.

Support for the curriculum
Support the use of information and communication technology in the classroom.
Have a responsibility for promoting and safeguarding the welfare of children and young people he/she is responsible for or comes into contact with.
To ensure tasks are carried out with due regard to Health and Safety.
To participate in appropriate professional development including adhering to the principle of appraisal/performance management.
To adhere to the ethos of Aiglon and promote the agreed vision and aims of the school while setting an example of personal integrity and professionalism.
Attendance at appropriate staff meetings, parents/open evenings, etc.
Any other duties as commensurate within the grade in order to ensure the smooth running of Aiglon.
OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably requested by the Deputy Head of the Junior School to assist in the smooth running of the team.
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.

title: Bilingual Primary Teacher / Headteacher, Lausanne Region
description:
A rare opportunity to help shape a small, high\-quality bilingual education  
Bilingual Primary Teacher / Headteacher, Lausanne Region  
A rare opportunity to help shape a small, high\-quality bilingual educational project from an early stage.  
A hands\-on role combining pedagogy, structure, and meaningful engagement with children and families.  
We are opening a new boutique bilingual primary school project in the Lausanne area and are looking for an experienced and inspiring educator to help guide and shape the project as it enters its next phase of development.  
This is a rare opportunity to contribute to an educational environment with a clear vision: combining strong Montessori foundations with a carefully guided transition towards structured academic learning.  
Alongside this role, we are continuing to build a small, high\-quality teaching team and welcome interest from experienced teachers who may wish to contribute to the project.  
The school:  
We are developing a small, family\-oriented primary environment, typically serving children from ages 4 through the later primary years.  
The early years (ages 4–6\) are fully Montessori. From age 6 onwards, children transition progressively into more structured academic learning, drawing on a broader range of complementary child\-centred pedagogical approaches, while maintaining a strong emphasis on independence, clarity of thinking, and academic excellence.  
The school is fully bilingual (French–English), with the aim of developing real fluency and academic capability in both languages.  
We place particular importance on individual attention, pastoral care, and a strong sense of community.  
The project is rooted in a spiritually open, non\-denominational approach, welcoming families of all backgrounds, and fostering respect, reflection, and a sense of meaning. This extends naturally into a strong connection with nature, outdoor learning, and the surrounding environment.  
The project is based in a warm, intimate setting with a private garden and outdoor play area, as well as nearby green spaces. The project builds on prior experience within a school\-designated setting.  
The project also benefits from access to an alpine environment in the Verbier region, supporting seasonal outdoor activities and contributing to a broader approach to physical development, resilience, and experiential learning.  
A core group of families, children, and educators is already engaged with the educational project, and we are now looking to bring additional structure and leadership as the project develops.  
Structure:  
The project combines a full\-time school programme aligning with the PER alongside a hybrid section supporting families from the homeschooling community already connected to the broader educational project.  
The role:  
The successful candidate will play a central, hands\-on role in the life of the project, working in close partnership with the founders to help shape and develop the school over time.  
This includes leading or supporting the day\-to\-day running, bringing structure and clarity to a growing environment, contributing to curriculum and educational development, guiding the Montessori to academic transition, and working closely with teachers and families.  
For candidates with appropriate experience and interest, the role may evolve towards broader pedagogical and organisational leadership within the school.  
As the project develops, the role may also involve engaging with relevant local authorities and contributing to the project’s formal structuring and development.  
This is a practical, engaged role with a strong presence in the classroom environment.  
Profile:  
We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in both French and English, holds recognised teaching qualifications, and has experience with primary\-aged children.  
The role would suit someone who enjoys being actively involved in the classroom, is happy to teach and support when needed, and brings a grounded, practical approach. A natural ease with children and an interest in building a school environment over time are essential.  
Experience with Montessori and/or international education would be an advantage.  
Team:  
We are also recruiting a small number of teaching positions to complement the existing team, particularly in French, science, mathematics, and physical education.  
Experienced teachers who are interested in contributing to a small, high\-quality bilingual environment are welcome to apply directly via this advert.  
Why join:  
This is an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to a project at an early but already active stage, within a small, high\-quality environment where relationships and impact are real.  
Applications:  
Please send your CV and a short note outlining your experience and educational approach.  
Bilingual Primary Teacher / Headteacher, Lausanne Region  
Une occasion rare de contribuer à façonner un projet éducatif bilingue de petite taille et de grande qualité dès ses premières étapes.  
Un rôle concret alliant pédagogie, organisation et engagement significatif auprès des enfants et des familles.  
Nous ouvrons un nouveau projet d’école primaire bilingue à taille humaine dans la région de Lausanne et recherchons un(e) éducateur(trice) expérimenté(e) et inspirant(e) pour accompagner et façonner le projet dans sa prochaine phase de développement.  
Il s’agit d’une occasion rare de contribuer à un environnement éducatif doté d’une vision claire : associer de solides fondements Montessori à une transition soigneusement accompagnée vers un apprentissage académique structuré.  
Parallèlement à ce poste, nous continuons à constituer une petite équipe enseignante de grande qualité et accueillons également les candidatures d’enseignants expérimentés souhaitant contribuer au projet.  
L’école :  
Nous développons un environnement primaire de petite taille, à caractère familial, accueillant généralement des enfants de 4 ans jusqu’aux dernières années du primaire.  
Les premières années (4–6 ans) sont entièrement Montessori. À partir de 6 ans, les enfants passent progressivement à un apprentissage académique plus structuré, s’appuyant sur un éventail plus large d’approches pédagogiques complémentaires centrées sur l’enfant, tout en maintenant un fort accent sur l’autonomie, la clarté de la pensée et l’excellence académique.  
L’école est entièrement bilingue (français–anglais), avec pour objectif de développer une véritable maîtrise et des compétences académiques dans les deux langues.  
Nous accordons une importance particulière à l’attention individuelle, à l’accompagnement pastoral et à un fort esprit de communauté.  
Le projet repose sur une approche spirituellement ouverte et non confessionnelle, accueillant des familles de tous horizons et favorisant le respect, la réflexion et le sens. Cette approche s’étend naturellement à un lien fort avec la nature, l’apprentissage en plein air et l’environnement.  
Le projet est installé dans un cadre chaleureux et intime, avec un jardin privé et un espace de jeux extérieur, ainsi que des espaces verts à proximité. Il s’appuie sur une expérience antérieure au sein d’un établissement déjà affecté à un usage scolaire.  
Le projet bénéficie également d’un accès à un environnement alpin dans la région de Verbier, favorisant des activités de plein air saisonnières et contribuant à une approche plus large du développement physique, de la résilience et de l’apprentissage par l’expérience.  
Un noyau de familles, d’enfants et d’éducateurs est déjà engagé dans le projet éducatif, et nous cherchons désormais à apporter davantage de structure et de leadership à mesure que le projet se développe.  
Structure :  
Le projet combine un programme scolaire à temps plein conforme au PER avec une section hybride destinée à accompagner des familles issues de la communauté de l’instruction à domicile déjà liée au projet éducatif dans son ensemble.  
Le poste :  
La personne retenue jouera un rôle central et concret dans la vie du projet, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les fondateurs afin de contribuer au développement de l’école au fil du temps.  
Cela comprend la direction ou le soutien au fonctionnement quotidien, l’apport de structure et de clarté dans un environnement en développement, la contribution au développement pédagogique et curriculaire, l’accompagnement de la transition entre Montessori et l’enseignement académique, ainsi qu’un travail étroit avec les enseignants et les familles.  
Pour les candidats disposant de l’expérience et de l’intérêt nécessaires, le poste pourra évoluer vers des responsabilités plus larges de direction pédagogique et organisationnelle au sein de l’école.  
À mesure que le projet se développe, le rôle pourra également impliquer des échanges avec les autorités locales compétentes ainsi qu’une contribution à la structuration et au développement formels du projet.  
Il s’agit d’un rôle pratique et engagé, avec une forte présence dans l’environnement de la classe.  
Profil :  
Nous recherchons une personne à l’aise en français et en anglais, titulaire de qualifications reconnues dans l’enseignement et possédant une expérience auprès d’enfants d’âge primaire.  
Ce poste conviendra à une personne qui apprécie d’être activement impliquée en classe, qui est heureuse d’enseigner et d’apporter son soutien lorsque cela est nécessaire, et qui adopte une approche pragmatique et concrète. Une aisance naturelle avec les enfants ainsi qu’un intérêt pour la construction d’un environnement scolaire dans la durée sont essentiels.  
Une expérience en pédagogie Montessori et/ou dans l’enseignement international constituerait un atout.  
Équipe :  
Nous recrutons également un petit nombre d’enseignants afin de compléter l’équipe existante, notamment en français, sciences, mathématiques et éducation physique.

title: Information Security & Data Privacy Manager
description:
Information Security \& Data Privacy Manager  
Level of employment: 100%  
Working place: Allschwil and Home\- Office  
For 26 years, Medgate has been bringing doctors directly to patients 24/7 thanks to telemedicine. At Medgate Switzerland, more than 300 motivated employees \- including over 130 permanently employed doctors \- are actively shaping the medicine of tomorrow with the help of future\-oriented digital health solutions.  
Those who treat patients remotely at Medgate receive intensive training in telemedicine at the beginning. The medical guidelines developed for the needs of telemedicine and continuously refined over the years are practice\-oriented and designed for remote treatment. The patient management system supports doctors in their treatment by using artificial intelligence, among other things. This means that doctors have less administrative work and can focus more specifically on their patients. The medicine of the future is already a reality at Medgate.  
With flexible working models and reliable duty scheduling, Medgate makes it easy to combine work, leisure and family life.  
Information Security \& Data Privacy Manager  
About the role  
Medgate is a leading player in the digital\-health market and a medical\-device manufacturer: we develop and operate applications — including AI copilots and CE\-marked Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) — that handle sensitive patient data under strict Swiss professional\-secrecy obligations. We run an integrated management system: an ISO 27001:2022 information\-security management system (ISMS) operating inside an ISO 13485:2016 / EU MDR quality management system.  
Compliance with information\-security and data\-privacy requirements is a supporting pillar of our business. In this role you support the Compliance Officer in operating and maintaining both management systems, running their day\-to\-day operational activities and growing your contribution over time. You will work in a modern, AI\-augmented environment: (Anthropic) is available as an AI assistant to support research, drafting, and document generation across compliance and privacy workflows.  
Your tasks  
You support the Compliance Officer in the planning and execution of projects and operational activities across the following areas:  
Information Security Management System (ISMS) — operate and maintain the ISO 27001:2022 ISMS: keep policies and documentation current, run the security\-exception register, document security incidents and track their remediation, and monitor vulnerabilities and threat sources to produce the periodic cyber report — in coordination with IT Security \& Operations.  
Supplier \& cloud security assessments — prepare and maintain security assessments for new and existing suppliers and cloud services, on a new\-engagement and yearly\-review cycle.  
Data privacy — support the data\-privacy management system under Swiss nDSG/FADP and EU GDPR: keep privacy documentation current, document and assess data\-breach incidents, and support the handling of data\-subject requests, in liaison with the (externally mandated) Data Protection Officer.  
Documentation, risk \& improvement — support internal IT and the business in generating and maintaining security and privacy documentation, risk management, monitoring and measurements, corrective actions and improvement measures — within the ISO 13485 / EU MDR quality management system.  
Training \& awareness — administer information\-security and data\-privacy training in the existing tools, support the yearly training plan, and grow into designing and delivering trainings over time.  
Audits — organise and support internal and external audit activities, including ISO 27001 certification and surveillance audits and medical\-device (Notified Body) audits; grow your content contribution over time.  
Coordination \& reporting — coordinate internal departments, intra\-group stakeholders and external providers on the treatment of compliance issues; track and report the status of project and operational compliance activities to internal stakeholders (optionally including the Medgate Group and the Group).  
Corporate projects — support corporate project activities; analyse problems and propose actions to remediate gaps.  
Your profile  
Advanced university or university of applied sciences degree in an engineering, scientific, or related discipline.  
Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.  
Professional experience in a regulated industry (e.g. medical devices, healthcare, or financial services) combined with strong organisational skills.  
Solid understanding of management systems, organisational structures, processes, regulatory requirements, and standards, particularly ISO 27001, the Swiss Data Protection Act (DSG/nDSG), and GDPR. An ISO 27001 Foundation and/or Internal Auditor certification is an advantage or can be obtained on the job. Knowledge of ISO 13485, EU MDR, the EU AI Act, and professional confidentiality obligations is an advantage, or a willingness to acquire this knowledge quickly.  
Ability to bridge business, compliance, and IT functions, translating regulatory requirements into practical and effective solutions.  
Passion for helping shape the responsible adoption of AI, digital health solutions, and emerging technologies within a highly regulated environment.  
Analytical mindset, strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to navigate complex challenges within regulatory frameworks and in a dynamic environment.  
Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, positively, and appropriately with diverse stakeholders while building trust and alignment.  
Experience with collaboration tools such as Microsoft 365, Jira, and Confluence; familiarity with security awareness, data privacy, and security operations tools is a plus.

title: European Legal Counsel
description:
European Legal Counsel (One\-Year Maternity Cover)  
Start date: Between October and November 2026 (subject to agreement)  
We are looking for a European lawyer to join our legal team on a maternity cover basis. This is an in\-house role for a lawyer who has a broad skillset and practical experience across a wide range of legal topics — spanning sustainability, HSEC, human rights, regulatory compliance, employment, and corporate and contract law. The selected candidate will work closely with teams across Glencore's industrial and marketing operations, providing practical, solutions\-oriented advice across a diverse range of matters.  
The main tasks and responsibilities include:  
Oversee legal aspects of HSEC and human rights programmes, including regulatory compliance and risk management.  
Provide legal support to the Responsible Sourcing team in connection with Glencore's responsible sourcing programme.  
Support the Sustainability and HSEC \& human rights teams on issues management, including stakeholder engagement and related legal risk.  
Provide legal advice and support on sustainability initiatives, including the development and implementation of policies and strategies to promote environmental stewardship and social responsibility.  
Monitor European regulatory developments across natural resources, mining, and energy, and advise on applicability and implementation implications.  
Draft, review, and negotiate a variety of commercial agreements for various parts of the business.  
Advise on employment law matters, including employment contracts, labour relations, and employee benefits.  
Support the Corporate Affairs teams with legal guidance on external communications, and reputational matters.  
The ideal candidate  
Degree in law and bar admission with additional qualifications such as an LL.M. or equivalent preferred.  
3\-5 years of post\-graduate experience in a generalist in\-house or private practice role, with exposure to some or all of the following: sustainability, HSEC, human rights, employment, commercial law and regulatory compliance.  
Full professional proficiency in either German or French, with fluent English language skills (written and verbal), Spanish language skills an advantage.  
Experience working in industrial or regulated sectors such as mining, energy, or manufacturing is highly desirable.  
Ability to handle multiple tasks, prioritise effectively, and work in a fast\-paced, multinational environment.  
Effective analytical, communication, and negotiation skills.  
Ability to build trusted relationships with different teams.  
Motivated and keen to develop skills and knowledge.  
A collaborative team member with a high level of trust and integrity.  
Basic familiarity with AI tools and an interest in using them to improve efficiency is an advantage.  
Holding a Swiss work permit or passport holder of CH / EU / EFTA.  
Benefits  
We are committed to providing benefits, which promote mental, physical, and financial well\-being. From healthy meal options in our restaurants and bistros to free use of the in\-house gym including sport classes with professional trainers.  
We reimburse public transport for commuting to work; alternatively, we offer free parking space.  
We provide tuition assistance for further education and training courses.  
We have a competitive parental leave policy. Our childcare benefits also include emergency childcare services and financial assistance towards daycare costs.  
Employees’ Swiss Pension 2nd pillar is fully paid by Glencore.  
Who we are  
Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that advance everyday life.  
With over 140,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 30 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of offices.  
Glencore’s customers are principally industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.

description:

Area Sales Manager Coffee UK \& Nordics  
Focusing on the expansion of our EMEA coffee business, you will take on a central role in market development and new customer acquisition. You will be responsible for UK and Scandinavia, playing a key part in further strengthening Haco AG's position as a development partner and manufacturer of soluble coffee products, private\-label and OEM solutions.  
We are looking for a Sales Manager who has a proven track record as hunter, who can win customers and who can fill a pipeline. This is a builder role.  
Your customers are seeking solutions for Retail, QSR, food service or industrial applications.  
Your products include soluble coffee products and liquid coffee concentrates.  
Your place of work is preferably located within the target markets and is managed remotely.  
Your Main Responsibilities  
You will identify, approach and win potential customers based on our strategy, your market knowledge and your network.  
You will manage and support the accounts you win by yourself. You are responsible for the customer end\-to\-end – from first contact to signed agreement as well as you will ensure ongoing support and care.  
You will build a qualified pipeline largely from scratch.  
Based on our strategic input and agreed targets, you will manage the market independently, including market\- and competitor analyses.  
For your segments, you will develop targeted growth strategies, create market development plans, execute them and adjust as needed.  
You will work closely with internal departments such as Product Management, R\&D, Operations, Quality and Supply Chain.  
You are responsible for revenue, sales volume and contribution margin within jointly defined guardrails. You define the terms and conditions for your market in coordination with sales leadership.  
You will feedback market signals like competitor activities, buyer needs, pricing benchmarks or product gaps actively back to adjust commercial strategy. As part of that you will shape a market map for your regions with competition, customers, prospects and product preferences.  
You will represent the company at relevant trade fairs, industry events and customer events.  
You will actively help shape the EMEA sales strategy for the Coffee business unit.  
What You Bring  
Several years of successful sales experience in an international B2B environment, ideally in the coffee, beverage or food industry. Experience in vending companies with own product range or with vending powder suppliers will work, too.  
Proven track record in new customer acquisition as well as in building and developing markets.  
Experience selling ingredient solutions for OEM or private label is an advantage.  
Existing network in the international coffee industry along with sound market knowledge in the target regions.  
Business education or degree with a focus on sales, marketing, or a comparable qualification.  
Fluent negotiation\-level English; German and additional European languages are an advantage.  
High level of initiative, strong closing skills and entrepreneurial thinking.  
Independent, structured, and results\-oriented way of working, along with a strong willingness to travel within Europe.  
Strong communication and negotiation skills, along with enthusiasm for building long\-term customer relationships.  
Passion for coffee, markets and international business development.  
What Awaits You  
An entrepreneurial role with significant scope for creativity and direct influence on the growth of a strategic business area.  
The opportunity to actively help shape international market expansion in the Coffee segment and unlock new business potential.  
Short decision\-making paths and a dedicated, interdisciplinary team.  
A flexible working model based in one of the target markets, with close connection to the team in Switzerland. jpide0fd547jm jit0730jm jiy26jm

title: Experienced Industrial Electrical Technician
description:
Ideal start date: 01/11/2026
Contract duration (in months): 60
Grade range: 3
Benchmark job: 300040 - Electrical Technician
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

What you'll do:
Within the CERN Engineering department (EN), the Electrical Engineering (EL) group is responsible for managing CERN's electrical distribution network, ranging from 400 kV to 400/230 V, which includes its operation, maintenance, renovation, control as well as forecasting energy consumption and handling relations with suppliers. Additionally, the group oversees the cabling infrastructure, managing everything from the installation and removal of control, water-cooled, and fiber optic cables to the maintenance of their supporting structures.

You will join the Maintenance and Operation (EN-EL-MO) section, responsible for the operation and maintenance of CERN's electrical network, the commissioning of new installations, and the execution of small-scale electrical works.
As an experienced industrial electrical technician in the EN-EL-MO section, you will be responsible for operating and maintaining part of CERN's high- and low-voltage electrical network.

Apply your expertise to support the operation, maintenance, consolidation and development of CERN's electrical transmission and distribution systems, the backbone of one of the world's largest and most powerful particle colliders. Join the CERN electrical engineering team. Take part!

Your responsibilities:
- Operate the high- and low-voltage network (lockouts, switching electrical equipment on and off, network reconfiguration).
- Perform troubleshooting and repairs, document interventions, and lead or contribute to the preparation of technical reports.
- Carry out regular inspections to ensure the reliability and safety of the electrical network.
- Act as the contact person for users connected to the electrical network within the assigned area.
- Supervise preventive and corrective maintenance activities, as well as electrical works.
- Contribute to electrical projects executed by the Group: participate in project meetings, assist in the definition of technical solutions, prepare and execute tests and commissioning activities, and perform acceptance tests on high- and low-voltage installations.
- Maintain accurate records of maintenance and operational activities, including work performed, issues encountered, and corrective actions taken.

Your profile:
- Good knowledge of high- and low-voltage electrical distribution systems and associated equipment.
- Proven experience in the operation and maintenance of electrical installations, including troubleshooting, fault diagnosis, repairs, and commissioning activities.
- Demonstrated ability to work autonomously while coordinating activities with users, contractors, and technical specialists in a multidisciplinary environment.
- Experience using a Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS) for recording maintenance and operational activities.
- Experience in reading, updating, and managing electrical drawings, technical documentation, and as-built records.
- Technical certificate or general secondary education or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Electrical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Operation and maintenance of electrical circuits and networks.
- Construction, test and commissioning of electrical circuits and networks.
- Knowledge of Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
- Drives work / projects along and sees them through to their conclusion.
- Takes responsibility for own actions and decisions.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Medical hazard:
Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions. Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

For more information about the position, please visit: https://careers.cern/jobs/en-el-mo-2026-164-ld/

- Support customers in meeting compliance, governance and data protection objectives.
- Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical security and compliance controls.

AI & Security Innovation

- Lead customer discussions around secure AI adoption and responsible use of Microsoft Copilot and Security Copilot.

- Define controls to protect sensitive data and identities in AI-enabled collaboration and cloud scenarios.

Die Bedürfnisse aller Patientinnen und Patienten stehen stets an erster Stelle.

Unsere starke Partnerschaft mit Kliniken aus dem ganzen Land ermöglicht Ihnen eine hochwertige Arbeitsumgebung und eine schnelle Anstellung.

Für mehrere äußerst interessante Arbeitgeber suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung fachlich qualifizierte und engagierte Personen als

Internistin oder Internist für die Patientenversorgung in einem Schweizer Kanton Ihrer Wahl.

Zuständigkeiten / Hauptaufgaben

Die folgenden Punkte variieren je nach Standort ein wenig.

- **Diagnose, Behandlung und Prävention:** Internisten befassen sich mit der Vorbeugung, Diagnose und konservativen (nicht-chirurgischen) Behandlung von Krankheiten der inneren Organe. Dazu gehören unter anderem Herz-Kreislauf-Erkrankungen, Diabetes, Erkrankungen der Atemwege (Lunge), Verdauungserkrankungen, Nierenleiden, hormonelle Störungen, rheumatische Erkrankungen, Infektionskrankheiten und Bluterkrankungen.
- Patientenanamnese und körperliche Untersuchung:
Sie erheben eine detaillierte Krankengeschichte (Anamnese) und führen umfassende körperliche Untersuchungen durch.
- Anordnung und Interpretation von Untersuchungen:
Sie entscheiden, welche Labor-, bildgebenden (z.B. Röntgen, Ultraschall) oder funktionellen Untersuchungen (z.B. EKG, Lungenfunktion) notwendig sind, ordnen diese an und interpretieren die Ergebnisse.
- Erstellung von Behandlungsplänen:
Basierend auf der Diagnose entwickeln sie individuelle Behandlungspläne, verschreiben Medikamente und überwachen den Therapieerfolg.
- Betreuung chronischer Erkrankungen:
Sie sind häufig die erste Anlaufstelle und betreuen Patienten mit chronischen Erkrankungen.
- Beratung zu Krankheitsmanagement und Prävention:
Sie beraten Patienten umfassend zum Umgang mit ihrer Krankheit, zu präventiven Maßnahmen und zur Gesundheitsförderung.
- Koordination der Patientenversorgung:
Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Fachärzten (z.B. Chirurgen, Kardiologen, Rheumatologen) und anderen Gesundheitsberufen zusammen, um eine ganzheitliche und interdisziplinäre Betreuung zu gewährleisten. Sie überweisen Patienten an Spezialärzte, wenn spezielle Behandlungen erforderlich sind.
- Notfallmedizinische Versorgung:
In der Notfallversorgung überwachen und behandeln Sie Patienten mit akut bedrohlichen Zuständen.
- Umfassende Betreuung:
Sie kümmern sich um Patienten aller Altersstufen, wobei besonders in der Praxis ältere und multimorbide Patienten (Patienten mit mehreren chronischen Erkrankungen) häufig sind. Sie sind auch in der Palliativmedizin tätig, um Patienten mit nicht heilbaren Krankheiten zu betreuen.
- Führungsverantwortung, Lehre und Forschung:
Sie übernehmen auch Führungsaufgaben in Kliniken, engagieren sich in der Ausbildung des medizinischen Nachwuchses und sind an wissenschaftlicher Forschung beteiligt.

Qualifikationen / Anforderungen

- Facharzttitel für Allgemeine Innere Medizin (AIM) gerne mit Spezialisierung sowie erfüllte Voraussetzungen für die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen
(EU-Facharzttitel, EU-Approbation und EU-Staatsbürgerschaft)
- Berufserfahrung mindestens 2 Jahre
- Freude an Teamarbeit, am Teaching von Kolleginnen/Kollegen in Weiterbildung und an konstruktiver, interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Eine offene, kommunikative Persönlichkeit mit einer patienten-, kunden- und mitarbeiterorientierten Grundhaltung und hohem Engagement
- Erfahrung in einer angiologischen (Kader-)Stellung
Qualifikation für die Durchführung von PTA von Vorteil
- Interesse und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Die MEBEKO-Anerkennungen müssen beim Bewerbungsbeginn nicht vorhanden sein, jedoch beim Stellenantritt. Bei der Einreichung der Unterlagen kann auf unsere Erfahrung zurückgegriffen werden.
- Stilsicheres Deutsch, resp. C1-Zertifikat

Leistungen der Anstellung

- Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
- Das Gehalt liegt bei ca. CHF 170.000,- bis CHF 200.000,- brutto pro Jahr bei Vollzeit und bemisst sich je nach Berufserfahrung, Aus- und Weiterbildung
- Vielfältige Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Landschaftlich reizvolle Arbeitsplätze zwischen Bergen und Seen
- Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement, diverse Angebote für Mitarbeiter, Work-Life-Balance
- Sehr gute Familien und Kinderbetreuung

Hilfe zum Start

Sie schätzen Herausforderungen, wollen neue Ziele erreichen und stellen sich gerne anspruchsvollen Aufgaben?

Es erwartet Sie bei Ihrem neuen Arbeitsplatz ein engagiertes und motiviertes Team, dem Zuverlässigkeit und Respekt wichtig sind. Es bietet sich Ihnen eine interessante, abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit in einem angenehmen Arbeitsklima mit hohem allgemein-medizinischem Wissenstransfer.

Wir garantieren Ihnen absolute Diskretion.

Unser Team vor Ort coacht und begleitet Sie durch den kompletten Bewerbungsprozess und hilft bei der Erlangung der MEBEKO-Anerkennung durch das SRK. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir Sie bei der Relocation in die Schweiz und bei praktischen Fragen (Anmeldung, Bankkonto, Versicherung etc.).

The Nestlé Group is the world's largest food and beverage company with 92\.6 billion Swiss Francs in sales in 2019\. It is present in 187 countries around the world, has 403 factories and its 291'000 employees are committed to Nestlé's purpose of enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. Nestlé offers a wide portfolio of products and services for people and their pets throughout their lives. Its more than 2000 brands range from global icons like Nescafé or Nespresso to local favourites. Company performance is driven by its Nutrition, Health and Wellness strategy. Nestlé is based in the Swiss town of Vevey where it was founded more than 150 years ago. Learn more about our Group and reasons to join us on  
Senior Quality Specialist  
Location: Orbe, Switzerland  
Work model: Office\-based / Full time  
Contract type / duration: Permanent  
Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.  
As a Senior Quality Specialist at Société des Produits Nestlé, your mission is to build trust and deliver the best consumer experience for beverage systems by ensuring food safety, compliance and quality by design. You'll make a difference by collaborating closely with project managers, quality teams, business stream managers, manufacturing partners, regulatory and legal experts, and suppliers. This is your opportunity to take ownership, grow your expertise, and make a difference at scale.  
How you'll make an impact as a Senior Quality Specialist  
Promoting quality by design across beverage system development so teams deliver safe, compliant and consumer\-focused innovations.  
Driving right\-first\-time quality for new systems, products, packaging and filling lines from early development through technical approval.  
Building robust validation plans and quality sign\-offs that align partners, strengthen decisions and reduce risks before launch.  
Ensuring food safety, product compliance and quality standards are embedded into development, manufacturing and supplier activities.  
Providing technical expertise to factories and consumer service teams so quality issues are resolved effectively and improvements are sustained.  
Sharing lessons learned, tools and expertise across sites to grow quality capabilities and support continuous improvement.  
What will make you successful  
Bringing strong quality, manufacturing, research and development, and beverage systems expertise to complex innovation projects, ideally supported by a degree or equivalent qualification in science, chemistry or packaging.  
Applying food safety, hazard analysis, product compliance, good manufacturing practices, verification and audit knowledge with confidence, with a certificate or master's in regulatory affairs or chemistry considered an advantage.  
Using problem\-solving, change management and continuous improvement skills to protect consumers and improve quality outcomes.  
Collaborating across functions, sites and external partners with clear communication, coaching skills and a solution\-focused mindset.  
Communicating fluently in English.  
Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.  
At Société des Produits Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)

Learning and development opportunities to grow your career  
Performance based bonus  
Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

Generous parental leave and comprehensive family support solutions  
Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

We are committed to an inclusive and respectful hiring experience and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations if needed. Our workplaces are fully accessible and supported by a strong safety culture, with modern installations and procedures to ensure a safe environment for everyone.  
The hiring process typically includes a video interview with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team, and a final discussion and offer. All information is treated confidentially.

description:
Strategic Sourcing Manager

Purpose of the role:

  *  Developing and executing global sourcing strategies for the assigned direct materials categories: e.g. machining parts (focus on turning and milling), Welding parts etc.
  *  Acting as a business partner to key stakeholders in business (Business Units, Engineering, etc.) and Operations (Product Line Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Production, Materials Management, etc.)
  *  The global category manager shall sustain the Global Strategic Sourcing Operating Model and provide the supply capability and capacity at best cost to support the company’s future business needs and protection of brand value
  *  Application of aligned sourcing processes, sustainable supplier assessments and development approach, a performing and regulatory compliant supply base footprint shall be established and actively managed, contributing to the enhancement of the supply base performance on Quality, Delivery and Cost (QCD)
  *  Realization of a measurable value >3% in recurring and P&L effective cost reductions per year across the global 3rd party spend in the assigned spend categories accompanied by a leveraged and benchmarked supply base management
  *  Grow and further develop a qualified and performing Best Cost Country Supply Base in line with the companies and operations BCC objectives preferably in Eastern Europe and manage a sustainable spend allocation


Responsibilities:

  *  Management of own material categories (capacity, knowledge management, performance)                
  *  Accountable for contributing to the global Direct Material & Supply Base Performance (QCD)        
  *  Representing own direct material categories within the VAT organization                              
  *  Accountable for the category specific achievement of the objectives of cost optimization, supply base optimization, geographic sourcing footprint and Best Cost Country Sourcing                          
  *  Providing forward-looking guidance on trends, threats and opportunities in own categories (eg. raw materials etc.)                          
  *  Active contribution to the bottom up alignment of the Direct Materials Category Team with the defined / set company objectives                                
  *  Interface to BU / Engineering for Strategic Sourcing activities along with the PDP (IP07) process  
  *  Act as a change agent in regards to main stakeholders
  *  Perform the development of category sourcing strategies applying and complying with defined methods and tools
  *  Active supplier relationship management of the global supply base within its own category perimeter in alignment with the category teams in Switzerland, Malaysia and Romania
  *  Ensure consistent application of all Sourcing Levers
  *  Contribution to main Sourcing KPIs
  *  Assembles and actively leads category specific / cross-functional sourcing board
  *  Actively monitors and performs a supply base risk assessment across its own categories
  *  Participates in and contributes to continuous improvement of direct material practices  


Qualifications:  

  *  5+ years in-depth strategic and operational sourcing experience with a solid working knowledge of global category management
  *  Demonstrated work experience on category specific production techniques and processes
  *  Knowledge about category sourcing markets
  *  Office Software / IT application (esp. Excel, Word, Power Point etc.)
  *  Sourcing in Eastern Europe, Asia and experience in Best Cost Country and spend relocation activities

title: Legal Officer Internal Market Division - Brussels
description:
Legal Officer Internal Market Division \- Brussels  
Do you want to be a part of a dynamic and ambitious intergovernmental organisation working for the promotion of free trade and economic integration across Europe and globally? The European Free Trade Association (EFTA) offers the opportunity for a motivated and highly skilled professional to join the Internal Market Division in Brussels as a Legal Officer. Here, you will be part of an organisation based on professionalism, cooperation, trust, responsibility and respect.  
The EFTA Secretariat serves the four EFTA States – Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland – and has offices in Geneva, Brussels and Luxemburg. The Brussels Office supports the EEA EFTA States in the management of the EEA Agreement and assists in preparing new legislation for integration into the Agreement.  
The Internal Market Division (IMD) is responsible for providing support and assistance to the EFTA States in their work related to the EEA Agreement and their contribution to the development of EEA\-relevant legislation.  
Division Internal Market Division Location Brussels Category/Level A4 Type/Duration of Appointment Fixed term three years. If considered desirable and in the organisation’s interest, an additional three\-year contract may be offered. Start Date Autumn 2026 Job Reference VA 14/2026  
Role Description  
We are looking for a highly motivated and qualified candidate to take on the rewardingpost as legal officer in IMD. The successful candidate will play an important role in IMD, cooperating closely with and providing legal advice to colleagues and to the EEA EFTA States.  
The main tasks of the successful applicant will be to:  
Provide legal services and advice to the EEA EFTA States and colleagues in IMD within a wide selection of policy areas covered by the EEA Agreement, Draft Decisions of the EEA Joint Committee to incorporate EEA\-relevant EU legal acts into the EEA Agreement,Draft legal and explanatory notes related to the management of the EEA Agreement,Cooperate closely with the IMD policy officers, administrative coordinators, Registrar and other members of EFTA’s EEA legal team,Cooperate closely with Ministries in the EEA EFTA States, the EFTA Missions to the EU and EU counterparts regarding the incorporation of EU legislation into the EEA Agreement, andContribute to EFTA’s outreach activities, sharing knowledge and building competence on how the EEA Agreement functions and its legal implications, by giving trainings and presentations in meetings and seminars.  
The successful candidate should be flexible and willing to take on other tasks, including non\-legal and administrative tasks, as required, and depending on the workload and needs within IMD.  
Essential Skills  
University master’s degree in lawMinimum five years relevant work experience in a national administration, international organisation, or other relevant private sector companyExperience working with EEA or EU law  
Excellent analytical skills and focus on results  
Ability to draft legal texts and opinions concisely, clearly, and swiftly in English Excellent organisational and communication skillsSelf\-reliance and autonomy, together with a facility for teamwork in a task\-oriented environmentFlexibility with a positive, service\-minded, and proactive attitude  
Ideal Skills  
Experience working in an international and multicultural environment  
A postgraduate degree in EEA and/or European Union law  
Interest and knowledge of new IT tools, included AI\-based solutions Working knowledge of German, Norwegian or Icelandic  
Employment Terms  
EFTA has a dynamic and diverse work environment with the opportunity to work in a team of highly qualified people. Here you will be part of an organisation based on professionalism, cooperation, trust, responsibility and respect.  
EFTA also offers:  
International career and learning opportunities. An inclusive environment with high regard for cultural differences. Competitive benefit package.  
Grade: A4  
Annual salary: EUR 117,072\.48  
Appointments are normally made at the first step of the grade. The Secretary\-General reserves the right to appoint a candidate at a level different from that advertised. Through its recruitment policy, the EFTA Secretariat wants to ensure diversity in terms of gender, age and culture.  
EFTA is an international organisation, and the salaries and related payments are normally exempt from income taxation by the EFTA Member States and in the host states of the EFTA duty stations. Depending on the candidate’s family status, benefits and allowances may apply.  
This position is open to nationals of all the EFTA States (Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland). Applicants must apply via the EFTA e\-recruitment tool.  
The EFTA Secretariat aims to ensure balanced representation of EEA EFTA States in the Division and specifically in the Legal Unit of IMD. We therefore encourage Norwegian and Liechtensteiner candidates to apply for this Legal Officer role.

title: Experienced Industrial Electrical Technician
description:
Ideal start date: 01/11/2026
Contract duration (in months): 60
Grade range: 3
Benchmark job: 300040 - Electrical Technician
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

What you'll do:
Within the CERN Engineering department (EN), the Electrical Engineering (EL) group is responsible for managing CERN's electrical distribution network, ranging from 400 kV to 400/230 V, which includes its operation, maintenance, renovation, control as well as forecasting energy consumption and handling relations with suppliers. Additionally, the group oversees the cabling infrastructure, managing everything from the installation and removal of control, water-cooled, and fiber optic cables to the maintenance of their supporting structures.

You will join the Maintenance and Operation (EN-EL-MO) section, responsible for the operation and maintenance of CERN's electrical network, the commissioning of new installations, and the execution of small-scale electrical works.
As an experienced industrial electrical technician in the EN-EL-MO section, you will be responsible for operating and maintaining part of CERN's high- and low-voltage electrical network.

Apply your expertise to support the operation, maintenance, consolidation and development of CERN's electrical transmission and distribution systems, the backbone of one of the world's largest and most powerful particle colliders. Join the CERN electrical engineering team. Take part!

Your responsibilities:
- Operate the high- and low-voltage network (lockouts, switching electrical equipment on and off, network reconfiguration).
- Perform troubleshooting and repairs, document interventions, and lead or contribute to the preparation of technical reports.
- Carry out regular inspections to ensure the reliability and safety of the electrical network.
- Act as the contact person for users connected to the electrical network within the assigned area.
- Supervise preventive and corrective maintenance activities, as well as electrical works.
- Contribute to electrical projects executed by the Group: participate in project meetings, assist in the definition of technical solutions, prepare and execute tests and commissioning activities, and perform acceptance tests on high- and low-voltage installations.
- Maintain accurate records of maintenance and operational activities, including work performed, issues encountered, and corrective actions taken.

Your profile:
- Good knowledge of high- and low-voltage electrical distribution systems and associated equipment.
- Proven experience in the operation and maintenance of electrical installations, including troubleshooting, fault diagnosis, repairs, and commissioning activities.
- Demonstrated ability to work autonomously while coordinating activities with users, contractors, and technical specialists in a multidisciplinary environment.
- Experience using a Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS) for recording maintenance and operational activities.
- Experience in reading, updating, and managing electrical drawings, technical documentation, and as-built records.
- Technical certificate or general secondary education or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Electrical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Operation and maintenance of electrical circuits and networks.
- Construction, test and commissioning of electrical circuits and networks.
- Knowledge of Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS).
- Drives work / projects along and sees them through to their conclusion.
- Takes responsibility for own actions and decisions.
- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.
- Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Participation in a regular stand-by duty, including nights, Sundays and official holidays.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Medical hazard:
Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions. Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

For more information about the position, please visit: https://careers.cern/jobs/en-el-mo-2026-164-ld/

title: Propellant Chemist
description:
Description
About the role

Imagine being at the core of propulsion innovation, shaping the very materials that power our high performance rocket systems. As a Propellant Engineer at Destinus, you will lead the formulation, development, and characterization of solid rocket propellants and thermal protection materials for high-performance rocket motor applications. This role is strongly hands-on and combines materials science, process development, and analytical rigor to deliver reliable, high-quality propulsion materials.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

Develop and optimize solid rocket propellant formulations, balancing performance, mechanical properties, stability, and manufacturability.
Lead laboratory-scale mixing, casting, curing, and post-processing activities in accordance with defined safety and quality standards.
Define and implement characterization methodologies for propellant materials, including mechanical, thermal, rheological, ballistic, ablation and aging evaluations.
Establish and document standard test procedures, acceptance criteria, and data analysis methods for propellant & TPS materials development and qualification.
Support the definition of process parameters and quality control for propellant and TPS manufacturing, including mixing, degassing, casting, curing, and storage.
Analyse formulation trade-offs and drive improvements in performance, robustness, and reproducibility.
Support rocket motor development programs by correlating material properties to motor performance and structural behaviour and thermal environments.
Lead or support investigation of material anomalies, aging effects, or performance deviations, driving root cause analysis and corrective actions.
Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, including formulation records, process specifications, characterization reports, and development plans.
Collaborate closely with propulsion, structures, manufacturing, and test teams to ensure seamless integration of propellant materials into motor designs.
Contribute to long-term technology development roadmaps for advanced propellant systems.
Requirements

What You’ll Need
BSc. or MSc. in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.
5+ years of experience in solid rocket propellant development or closely related polymer/composite material systems.
Experience with propellant formulation, mixing, casting, and curing processes.
Strong understanding of polymer-bonded systems, composite materials, and viscoelastic behaviour.
Experience defining and conducting material characterization programs, including mechanical, thermal, and aging testing.
Familiarity with establishing standard operating procedures and structured development processes.
Analytical mindset with the ability to translate material data into engineering decisions.
Strong documentation discipline and ability to work in a safety-critical environment.
Ability to work hands-on in laboratory and pilot-scale environments.
Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
Fluency in English required; German is a plus.

Who You Are
You are a propulsion minded materials expert who feels at home in the lab and on the production floor. You understand polymer bonded propellants not just in theory but in practice, from formulation strategy to mixing, casting, curing, and final characterization. You are comfortable defining the technical path forward while also building the processes, documentation, and qualification methods that make materials flight ready and repeatable.

Benefits
Why Join Us?

The Thrill of the Future – Work on cutting-edge projects that redefine aerospace.
Global Innovation Hub – Collaborate with top engineers from all over the world.
Fast-Paced & High-Growth – Experience the rush of working in a rapidly expanding company.
Real Impact – Your work won’t be theoretical—it will shape the future of flight.

Destinus is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity in our companies and our teams and do not discriminate based on age, race, religion, color, country of origin, gender, sexual orientation, or disability status.

Destinus – Challenge the limits of time, space, and human potential.

title: Programme Associate
description:
Oak Foundation's mission (  
Programme Associate  
Oak Foundation's mission ( is to contribute to a safer, fairer, and more sustainable world. With offices in Europe, Africa, and North America, Oak Foundation makes grants to organisations globally.  
This is a great opportunity to join a diverse, international team within Oak Foundation’s Environment Programme team. The programme comprises three interconnected sub\-programmes: Marine Food Systems and Livelihoods, Nature and People, and Regenerative Landscapes. Through a systems\-change approach we seek to address the root causes of environmental and social challenges, generating lasting benefits for people and biodiversity. Grant management and portfolio support

Strategic analysis, learning, and reporting

Facilitate communication and the sharing of information among programme staff, grantees, and external stakeholders.

Manage programme knowledge management systems and ensure information is organised, accessible, and effectively maintained.  
Support the collection and synthesis of partner stories, research, publications, and lessons.  
Operations and administration

Contribute to the continuous improvement of programme systems, workflows, and reporting processes.  
Support the team with use of technology.

The ideal candidate will have the following qualifications and profile:  
University Degree or evidenced equivalent experience in a relevant field.

Ability to take initiative, to work independently, and as part of a team.  
Strong analytical skills.  
Successful track record of multi\-tasking, and the ability to serve a seven\-person team with competing needs and requirements.

title: Information Security & Data Privacy Manager
description:
Information Security \& Data Privacy Manager  
Level of employment: 100%  
Working place: Allschwil and Home\- Office  
For 26 years, Medgate has been bringing doctors directly to patients 24/7 thanks to telemedicine. At Medgate Switzerland, more than 300 motivated employees \- including over 130 permanently employed doctors \- are actively shaping the medicine of tomorrow with the help of future\-oriented digital health solutions.  
Those who treat patients remotely at Medgate receive intensive training in telemedicine at the beginning. The medical guidelines developed for the needs of telemedicine and continuously refined over the years are practice\-oriented and designed for remote treatment. The patient management system supports doctors in their treatment by using artificial intelligence, among other things. This means that doctors have less administrative work and can focus more specifically on their patients. The medicine of the future is already a reality at Medgate.  
With flexible working models and reliable duty scheduling, Medgate makes it easy to combine work, leisure and family life.  
Information Security \& Data Privacy Manager  
About the role  
Medgate is a leading player in the digital\-health market and a medical\-device manufacturer: we develop and operate applications — including AI copilots and CE\-marked Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) — that handle sensitive patient data under strict Swiss professional\-secrecy obligations. We run an integrated management system: an ISO 27001:2022 information\-security management system (ISMS) operating inside an ISO 13485:2016 / EU MDR quality management system.  
Compliance with information\-security and data\-privacy requirements is a supporting pillar of our business. In this role you support the Compliance Officer in operating and maintaining both management systems, running their day\-to\-day operational activities and growing your contribution over time. You will work in a modern, AI\-augmented environment: (Anthropic) is available as an AI assistant to support research, drafting, and document generation across compliance and privacy workflows.  
Your tasks  
You support the Compliance Officer in the planning and execution of projects and operational activities across the following areas:  
Information Security Management System (ISMS) — operate and maintain the ISO 27001:2022 ISMS: keep policies and documentation current, run the security\-exception register, document security incidents and track their remediation, and monitor vulnerabilities and threat sources to produce the periodic cyber report — in coordination with IT Security \& Operations.  
Supplier \& cloud security assessments — prepare and maintain security assessments for new and existing suppliers and cloud services, on a new\-engagement and yearly\-review cycle.  
Data privacy — support the data\-privacy management system under Swiss nDSG/FADP and EU GDPR: keep privacy documentation current, document and assess data\-breach incidents, and support the handling of data\-subject requests, in liaison with the (externally mandated) Data Protection Officer.  
Documentation, risk \& improvement — support internal IT and the business in generating and maintaining security and privacy documentation, risk management, monitoring and measurements, corrective actions and improvement measures — within the ISO 13485 / EU MDR quality management system.  
Training \& awareness — administer information\-security and data\-privacy training in the existing tools, support the yearly training plan, and grow into designing and delivering trainings over time.  
Audits — organise and support internal and external audit activities, including ISO 27001 certification and surveillance audits and medical\-device (Notified Body) audits; grow your content contribution over time.  
Coordination \& reporting — coordinate internal departments, intra\-group stakeholders and external providers on the treatment of compliance issues; track and report the status of project and operational compliance activities to internal stakeholders (optionally including the Medgate Group and the Group).  
Corporate projects — support corporate project activities; analyse problems and propose actions to remediate gaps.  
Your profile  
Advanced university or university of applied sciences degree in an engineering, scientific, or related discipline.  
Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.  
Professional experience in a regulated industry (e.g. medical devices, healthcare, or financial services) combined with strong organisational skills.  
Solid understanding of management systems, organisational structures, processes, regulatory requirements, and standards, particularly ISO 27001, the Swiss Data Protection Act (DSG/nDSG), and GDPR. An ISO 27001 Foundation and/or Internal Auditor certification is an advantage or can be obtained on the job. Knowledge of ISO 13485, EU MDR, the EU AI Act, and professional confidentiality obligations is an advantage, or a willingness to acquire this knowledge quickly.  
Ability to bridge business, compliance, and IT functions, translating regulatory requirements into practical and effective solutions.  
Passion for helping shape the responsible adoption of AI, digital health solutions, and emerging technologies within a highly regulated environment.  
Analytical mindset, strong problem\-solving skills, and the ability to navigate complex challenges within regulatory frameworks and in a dynamic environment.  
Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, positively, and appropriately with diverse stakeholders while building trust and alignment.  
Experience with collaboration tools such as Microsoft 365, Jira, and Confluence; familiarity with security awareness, data privacy, and security operations tools is a plus.

(Senior) Bioanalytical Principal Investigator LBS / GLP Study Director (100%)  
In this role, you will take scientific and operational ownership of regulated bioanalytical studies and method validations. You will serve as the primary client contact, lead study execution from planning through reporting, and play a key role in delivering high\-quality data to support drug development programs worldwide.

Study Leadership \& Scientific Oversight

Act as Study Director and/or Principal Investigator with full responsibility for assigned studies or study phases.  
Develop and approve study plans, validation protocols, analytical reports and associated study documentation.  
Review, evaluate and approve analytical data to ensure scientific integrity and regulatory compliance.  
Ensure all study activities are conducted in accordance with applicable SOPs, regulatory requirements and client expectations.  
Client Management

Support client meetings, scientific discussions and audits as required.  
Operational Excellence  
Coordinate laboratory activities and ensure efficient study execution.  
Train, mentor and support assigned laboratory personnel.  
Contribute to process improvements and continuous enhancement of laboratory operations and quality standards.  
Support bioanalytical data management activities and documentation review processes.  
Additional Responsibilities for Senior\-Level Candidates  
Lead complex or strategic client programs.  
Provide scientific mentoring and guidance to junior Principal Investigators and laboratory staff.  
Act as a subject expert for ligand\-binding and cell\-based assay technologies.  
Contribute to business development activities, client presentations and scientific initiatives.﻿  
Your Profile  
﻿Required Qualifications  
Degree in Biochemistry, Biology, Chemistry or a related scientific discipline; PhD is advantageous.  
Minimum 2 years of experience in bioanalysis or quantitative analytical sciences.  
Hands\-on experience with ligand\-binding assays and/or cell\-based assays.  
Experience working in a regulated environment (GLP, GCP, GMP and/or ISO standards).  
Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.  
Ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.  
Preferred Qualifications  
Previous experience as a Study Director, Principal Investigator or equivalent scientific leadership role.  
Knowledge of biomarker, pharmacokinetic (PK), immunogenicity (ADA) or biologics bioanalysis.  
Good German language skills.  
Experience working directly with pharmaceutical or biotechnology clients.  
What We Offer  
The opportunity to lead scientifically challenging projects for global pharmaceutical and biotech clients.  
Exposure to innovative biologics, biomarkers and emerging therapeutic modalities.  
A collaborative, international and science\-driven working environment.  
Structured onboarding and continuous professional development opportunities.  
Modern laboratories and state\-of\-the\-art infrastructure.  
Flexible working hours and attractive employment conditions.  
The opportunity to grow your career within a globally recognized CRO.  
A workplace located near Zurich with easy access to excellent public transportation and recreational opportunities.  
Why Join Celerion?  
At Celerion, you will contribute directly to the development of new medicines while working alongside highly skilled scientists in a dynamic and supportive environment. We value scientific excellence, teamwork, integrity and innovation, and we are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed.  
Celerion is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.

We look forward to receiving your application.

The Nestlé Group is the world's largest food and beverage company with 92\.6 billion Swiss Francs in sales in 2019\. Senior Quality Specialist  
Location: Orbe, Switzerland

Be a force for good and accelerate change that improves lives and the planet.

Promoting quality by design across beverage system development so teams deliver safe, compliant and consumer\-focused innovations.  
Driving right\-first\-time quality for new systems, products, packaging and filling lines from early development through technical approval.  
Building robust validation plans and quality sign\-offs that align partners, strengthen decisions and reduce risks before launch.  
Ensuring food safety, product compliance and quality standards are embedded into development, manufacturing and supplier activities.  
Providing technical expertise to factories and consumer service teams so quality issues are resolved effectively and improvements are sustained.  
Sharing lessons learned, tools and expertise across sites to grow quality capabilities and support continuous improvement.  
What will make you successful  
Bringing strong quality, manufacturing, research and development, and beverage systems expertise to complex innovation projects, ideally supported by a degree or equivalent qualification in science, chemistry or packaging.  
Applying food safety, hazard analysis, product compliance, good manufacturing practices, verification and audit knowledge with confidence, with a certificate or master's in regulatory affairs or chemistry considered an advantage.  
Using problem\-solving, change management and continuous improvement skills to protect consumers and improve quality outcomes.  
Collaborating across functions, sites and external partners with clear communication, coaching skills and a solution\-focused mindset.  
Communicating fluently in English.  
Demonstrating courage, collaboration, speed and continuous learning.  
At Société des Produits Nestlé, we place people at the heart of everything we do.

Flexible working options, including hybrid work possibilities (for office based roles)  
Paid holidays beyond legal requirements  
Learning and development opportunities to grow your career  
Performance based bonus  
Healthcare contribution and access to the Employee Assistance Program

Attractive employee discounts across various products and services

title: European Legal Counsel
description:
European Legal Counsel (One\-Year Maternity Cover)

We are looking for a European lawyer to join our legal team on a maternity cover basis. This is an in\-house role for a lawyer who has a broad skillset and practical experience across a wide range of legal topics — spanning sustainability, HSEC, human rights, regulatory compliance, employment, and corporate and contract law. The selected candidate will work closely with teams across Glencore's industrial and marketing operations, providing practical, solutions\-oriented advice across a diverse range of matters.

Oversee legal aspects of HSEC and human rights programmes, including regulatory compliance and risk management.
